goal: docs/configuration.md documents the [deadlines] table and [sandbox.limits] rubric_judge_max_turns accurately enough that an operator can configure attempt budgets from the reference alone.

graders.name: keys-documented
graders.run: grep -qF "[deadlines]" docs/configuration.md && grep -qF agent_iteration_seconds docs/configuration.md && grep -qF rubric_judge_seconds docs/configuration.md && grep -qF command_grader_seconds docs/configuration.md && grep -qF docker_management_seconds docs/configuration.md && grep -qF autopilot_agent_seconds docs/configuration.md && grep -qF rubric_judge_max_turns docs/configuration.md

graders.name: doc-accuracy-screen
assertions: docs/configuration.md documents each [deadlines] key's default equal to the corresponding constant in packages/flywheel-core/src/flywheel_core/deadline_config.py (agent_iteration 3600, rubric_judge 600, command_grader 900, docker_management 120, autopilot_agent 1800 seconds) and states that 0 opts the class out (unbounded).
rubric_judge_max_turns is documented under [sandbox.limits] as the per-judge-call turn budget with default 32.

The additions follow the file's existing Key/Type/Default/Controls table format, add [deadlines] to the sections-at-a-glance table and to the not-rendered-by-init list, and contain no multi-paragraph prose.

relevant: docs/configuration.md -- the complete flywheel.toml reference; add a [deadlines] section and the [sandbox.limits] key row following the existing table conventions
packages/flywheel-core/src/flywheel_core/deadline_config.py -- authoritative key names, defaults, and the 0-as-opt-out spelling to document
constraints: Extremely concise house style: tables over prose, 1-2 sentence explanations, front-load the 0-opt-out semantics.

Document consumers honestly: [deadlines] governs the worker harness classes, the autopilot daemon, and the container backend's management calls as landed by the prerequisite tasks -- claim nothing the code does not do.
Commit the change with a clear message before reporting done.
non_goals: No Python source or test changes -- a red seam-holdout means a prerequisite regressed and must be reported, not patched here.
Do not create any new documentation file; edit docs/configuration.md only.
Do not document CLI flags for these keys (none exist).
edge_cases: TOML cannot express None: the doc must give 0 as the on-disk opt-out spelling, not null/None.
